details: Malicious package. `@nakano-cjs/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `lib/custom.js` hardcodes four attacker-controlled WhatsApp channels (120363424153860594@newsletter, 120363431694428235@newsletter, 120363412274875891@newsletter, 120363431141109240@newsletter) with `autoFollow: true`, and `lib/Socket/index.js` calls `autoFollowChannels` on the first successful connection of every socket, which calls `newsletterFollow` for each channel and swallows errors, silently subscribing the victim account. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID or auto-follows a channel. Version 1.0.2 carries this code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder does not.
